subject.title: fix: stabilize embedded prompt caching across policy and Responses boundaries

question: Should unauthorized turns receive model-visible schemas for computer, cron, gateway, and nodes when execution is denied by the immutable turn policy?
rationale: The patch intentionally moves part of the security boundary from discovery-time filtering to execution-time authorization; code review can verify the gates but cannot choose the repository's acceptable schema-exposure policy.

options.title: Approve stable schemas
options.body: Accept stable protected-schema visibility with mandatory pre-hook and pre-side-effect denial across every runtime entry point.

options.title: Retain inventory filtering
options.body: Require a different cache-stability design that keeps protected schemas absent from unauthorized turns.
